name: checkin
description: Private weekly learner check-in evidence and score-driven estimate changes. Raw speaking and writing answers are never stored.

user_id.description: Buildy account id of the owning learner

profile_id.description: Learner profile used for this check-in

roadmap_id.description: Roadmap version active when the check-in began

week_plan_id.description: Weekly plan that supplied this check-in

checkin_key.description: Best-effort owner and local-week idempotency key

track.description: Learning track used to select and interpret evidence

week_start_local.description: Learner-local Monday date for the checked-in week

listening_correct_count.description: Correct answers out of the approved listening items shown

listening_total_count.description: Number of approved listening items shown

listening_comparison.description: Three-item comparison band for listening evidence

reading_correct_count.description: Correct answers out of the approved reading items shown

reading_total_count.description: Number of approved reading items shown

reading_comparison.description: Three-item comparison band when reading is weighted

grammar_correct_count.description: Correct approved grammar/vocabulary answers when reading is not weighted

grammar_comparison.description: Sub-area comparison only when grammar replaces unweighted reading

grammar_evidence_only.description: True when grammar evidence is diagnostic and does not move a skill estimate

writing_status.description: Whether the existing writing scorer returned a valid level

writing_scored_level.description: CEFR level returned by the existing writing scorer, blank if unavailable

writing_comparison.description: Writing scorer level compared with the saved estimate

speaking_self_rating.description: Learner self-rating retained for history only; never changes speaking estimate

speaking_self_rating_label.description: Display label identifying speaking evidence as self-rated and not assessed

before_values_json.description: JSON planning estimates before this check-in

after_values_json.description: JSON planning estimates after scored evidence; speaking is unchanged

deltas_json.description: JSON per-skill estimate changes, each bounded to one quarter step

comparisons_json.description: JSON comparison bands from scored listening, reading, and writing evidence

what_changed_note.description: One-line note naming only estimates that numerically moved from scored evidence
